Nina T: Quick heads-up 
Were kicking off a 1hr conformance sweep for third-party tooling tomorrow 9am PT. Focus: LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters, gateway headers, and marketplace manifest parity. Post any blockers here.

Omar R: I can run the LangChain runner flows and verify token refresh behavior. Will need a sandbox tenant.

Grace C: Ill do LlamaIndex vector store roundtrip + cache validation. Also will probe model-variant fallback across Dedicated vs Hosted.

Nina T: Nice. Ill provision a sandbox tenant and short-lived creds. Expect DM in 10. Also toggling gateway debug so we can see routing decisions.

Victor S: For marketplace: Ill validate that manifest retrieval returns stable schema and that checksum/etag header present. Will assert no publish side-effects.

integrations-bot: Reminder: blackout window requested by @marketing for joint-announcement: 2026-05-02T00:00:00Z -> 2026-05-04T23:59:59Z. Please avoid outward comms in that span.

Omar R: Local smoke curl (replace $SANDBOX_TOKEN):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://gateway.redwood-inference/smoke/adapter \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Client-App: langchain-runner" \
  -d '{"input":"test","pipeline":["embed","qa"]}' | jq .
```
Look for "status":"ok" and presence of "X-Redwood-Routing" header in response metadata.

Grace C: Note: when testing Dedicated fallback, set header X-Prefer-Dedicated: true to force pool selection. Watch for cold-start ~1-3s on 7B.

Nina T: Also capture these headers: X-Redwood-Latency-ms, X-Model-Version, X-Redwood-Routing. Save to /tmp/conformance-logs/<run>-<user>.json.

Victor S: Marketplace manifest fetch curl (no auth required for this check):
```bash
curl -s https://marketplace.redwood-inference/api/v1/listings/my-tool/manifest.yaml -I
```
Expect 200 + ETag and Content-Length. If 404, raise ticket to marketplace team.

Omar R: Quick question: do we have a standard test prompt set for quality gating? Id like to check that reranking order is preserved between hosted/dedicated variants.

Grace C: We have a tiny prompt pack in repo tools/interop/promptsets/basic.json. Use that and assert top-1 similarity score > 0.85.

Nina T: scheduling job now: integr-bot run-conformance 2026-05-01T16:00:00Z tag: thirdparty-conformance-sweep

integrations-bot: Job queued: thirdparty-conformance-sweep at 2026-05-01T16:00:00Z. Owners: Nina T, Omar R, Grace C. CI link: https://ci.redwood-inference/interop/1795559999

Victor S: Adding SI owner @Elena P for any connector credential issues. Elena, FYI when you have a min pls.

Elena P: On it — will standby for creds and will run connector auth smoke. Expect ~15m prep.

Nina T: Final call: if no objections we run tomorrow. Report quick pass/fail and attach /tmp logs. :rocket:
